source_caption:
🎬 Just Like Heaven (2005)

Just Like Heaven follows David Abbott, a lonely landscape architect who moves into a beautiful San Francisco apartment while struggling to overcome the loss of his wife. His peaceful new life takes an unexpected turn when Elizabeth Masterson, a hardworking doctor, mysteriously appears in his apartment and insists that it belongs to her. David soon discovers that Elizabeth is a spirit who cannot remember what happened to her, and he appears to be the only person who can see and communicate with her. Although their relationship begins with constant arguments and hilarious misunderstandings, the two gradually develop a deep emotional connection as they attempt to uncover the truth behind her mysterious condition. As David helps Elizabeth rediscover her past, he finds himself falling in love with someone he never expected to meet. Starring Reese Witherspoon and Mark Ruffalo, the film beautifully combines romance, comedy, and supernatural fantasy while exploring love, loss, destiny, second chances, and the extraordinary connections that can change our lives forever.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 35m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Mark Waters

✍️ Writers: Peter Tolan & Leslie Dixon

📚 Based On: The novel If Only It Were True by Marc Levy.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Paramount+ for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Just Like Heaven is a 2005 American fantasy romantic comedy film directed by Mark Waters and starring Reese Witherspoon and Mark Ruffalo. It is based on the 1999 French novel If Only It Were True (Et si c'était vrai...) by Marc Levy. Lonely landscape architect David Abbot finds an amazing San Francisco apartment to sublet, only to find it is inhabited by Elizabeth Masterson, the spirit of the overachieving doctor previous tenant. Steven Spielberg obtained the rights to produce the film from the book.
